items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: oh one of my favorites, I was on tour with him, I was on tour twice with, what do they call that, “Masters of the Steel String Guitar”

ctx.x: I don’t think I’ve ever seen a jazz guitar player with a capo.

No. Some of the blues players use them quite a bit, some of the old — oh one of my favorites, I was on tour with him, I was on tour twice with, what do they call that, “Masters of the Steel String Guitar” — it’s some kind of endowment thing, arts endowment thing.
